# Color font fixture

`twemoji-smiley-glyf-colr1.ttf` is copied from
[`googlefonts/color-fonts`](https://github.com/googlefonts/color-fonts/blob/main/fonts/twemoji_smiley-glyf_colr_1.ttf)
at revision `main` as retrieved on 2026-10-29.

- Upstream SHA-256: `b462e4de616a38979b053a49b0b5a5f2dd72b6d5f55be43c5b1eb812fd438dbc`
- Size: 7,420 bytes
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Upstream license: <https://github.com/googlefonts/color-fonts/blob/main/LICENSE>

The fixture contains a small glyf/COLR/CPAL Twemoji smiley subset. Tests use
U+1F601, whose COLR program is four solid, untransformed layers, and U+263A,
whose COLR program includes transforms for deterministic unsupported-operation
fallback coverage.
